issues.what: The follow-up's central multiplicity claim is wrong: it reports that the revised harness.spa excluded no candidate on either timeframe because 'every grid variant's selection gain is non-zero in every active session (no variant applies the Foundation's next-CHoCH exit, so every variant differs from the benchmark wherever a session has a trade)', and therefore that the studentised SPA p is unchanged. In fact the exclusion rule is inert for this family because harness.spa counts a session as active when |gain| > 1e-9, and the lab.manage replay prices an exit identical to the L1 label with ~1e-5 to 5e-3 INR of arithmetic noise (the study's own grid check only asserts 'net within 0.005'). The near-benchmark variants the previous refuter flagged are therefore still in the studentised family and still inflate the bootstrap null. The reported studentised SPA p-values (minute 0.396 / 0.3965, 5-minute 0.4965 / 0.4825) are artefact-inflated; the pass-rule verdict does not flip (corrected p still > 0.10 and the top-1%-removed item fails independently), so the null result survives, but the numbers, the 'excluded candidates: none' statement and the explanation in section 10.2 are incorrect and the item the follow-up was tasked to fix is not fixed.
issues.where: FINDINGS.md:62 and :101 ('0 of 1568 candidates excluded from the studentised family (none)'), FINDINGS.md:236 (section 10.2 explanation), FINDINGS.md:218/220/222/224/226/228 (pass-rule SPA items); findings.json timeframes.*.spa.excluded_candidates = [] (lines 331, 1669), followup.spa_old_to_new (lines 2715-2754), followup.what_changed[1] (line 2757); 05_evaluate.py:78 and :83 (active = |gain| > 1e-9, mirroring harness.py:484); the summary's 'excluded_candidates: none on either timeframe' sentence.
issues.evidence: Reproduced from the exit-ledger vectors with harness.selection_gain and the study's own bootstrap tags (the reported numbers reproduce exactly first: minute family SPA p 0.396 / RC 0.501 / unstudentised 0.5405 / 0.6845, best 785; 5-minute 0.4965 / 0.5175 / 0.1505 / 0.2465, best 1025; all-trials 0.3965 and 0.4825). Then: the per-session |gain| values split cleanly into pricing noise (max 0.00528 INR on minute, 0.00487 on 5-minute) and genuine exit differences (min 0.0104 and 0.0374). Every one of the 1568 variants has at least one noise-only session; the harness counts all 1568 as active in 578/578 (408/408) sessions. Variant 1177 (stop foundation / scale none / trail none / time_stop None / choch True) on 5-minute has gains [812.53, 0.0049, 0.0048, ...]: genuinely active in 1 of 408 sessions (min-active threshold 20); variant 1183 (same + inert 120-bar time stop) is identical. On minute variant 1177 has gains [85.58, 76.98, 64.60, 55.95, 50.81, 35.74, 0.59, 0.0049, ...]: genuinely active in 7 of 578 (threshold 28). In the studentised bootstrap null these degenerate candidates are the argmax in 37.7% of the 2000 draws on 5-minute (19.7% on minute); the median null max drops from 2.61 to 1.68 (5-minute) when they are excluded. Recomputing harness.spa's arithmetic with the same draws and recentring but excluding candidates with fewer than min_active sessions of |gain| > 0.01 INR: minute family RC p 0.501 -> 0.448, SPA p 0.396 -> 0.322 (best still 785, t 1.683); minute all-trials 0.3965 -> 0.314; 5-minute family RC p 0.5175 -> 0.21, SPA p 0.4965 -> 0.185 (best still 1025, t 2.761); 5-minute all-trials 0.4825 -> 0.1685. harness.py:474-480's docstring states the exclusion exists precisely to remove such near-zero-variance candidates ('the exit-policy refuter's finding'), so the revision's intent was not realised.
issues.fix: Do not edit the ledgers or c_select outputs. Either (a) have the orchestrator change harness.spa's active test to a tolerance above the replay's pricing noise (e.g. |gain| > 0.01 INR, or snap a variant's per-trade net to the L1 net where the exit bar and price equal the label's) and re-run 05_evaluate.py for both timeframes then 06_findings.py, or (b) in the study, pass the corrected exclusion explicitly and report both the harness-as-is and the corrected studentised p, naming the excluded candidates (minute: variant 1177 [7 genuine sessions]; 5-minute: variants 1177 and 1183 [1 genuine session]). Replace the sentence in section 10.2 with the measured facts: variant 1177 is identical to the Foundation exit in 571/578 (407/408) sessions, the harness's 1e-9 test does not see this, and the corrected studentised SPA p is ~0.32 (minute) and ~0.18 (5-minute) — still > 0.10, verdict unchanged. Update findings.json spa.excluded_candidates and followup.spa_old_to_new accordingly.
